description:
Action: Presolicitation Notice

Agency: Agency: U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA), Natural Resources Conservation Service (NRCS), Mississippi

Notice Type: Presolicitation

Posted Date: March 5, 2026

Response Deadline: March 20, 2026

Solicitation Release Date (Estimated): March 23, 2026

Anticipated Proposal Due Date: March 27, 2026

Anticipated Award Date: March 30, 2026

Period of Performance: 4/1/2026 – 9/30/2026

NAICS: 541611 (Administrative Management and General Management Consulting Services)

1. Description

The USDA intends to issue a Request for BPA Call Order Proposals under the existing USDA‑wide Financial Management Support Services BPAs. The Government requires a certified public accounting firm to conduct an Agreed‑Upon Procedures (AUP) engagement over the Deepwater Horizon NRDA Restoration Funds. The AUP engagement covers the period of April 2016 through December 31, 2025, and includes verification of the Statement of Receipts and Expenditures and compliance with governing agreements, resolutions, and Standard Operating Procedures. The engagement shall be performed in accordance with GAGAS Chapter 7 and AICPA SSAE 18.  Deliverables include the Independent Accountant’s AUP Report, a report of procedures and findings, and observations/recommendations.

2. Competition

This requirement will be competed only among the three existing Small Business BPA Master Holders under previously awarded Firm‑Fixed‑Price BPAs:

• 1232SA23A0003 – Next Step

• 1232SA23A0004 – Pembroke Partners LLC

• 1232SA23A0005 – TFC Consulting, Inc.

3. Contract Type

A Firm‑Fixed‑Price call order will be issued under the applicable BPA.

4. Set‑Aside Status

This BPA call order will remain under the original small business set-aside associated with the BPA Master awards.

Only the BPA holders listed in Section 2 are eligible to compete.  No responses from non‑BPA holders will be accepted.

5. Points of Contact

Point of Contact (POC):
Paige Appelt: paige.appelt@usda.gov ;

Chanda Sow: Chanda.sow@usda.gov ; and

Oksana Strekha: oksana.strekha@usda.gov

6. Important Notes (FAR Compliance):

This notice is issued solely for information and planning purposes under FAR Part 5; it does not commit the Government to contract for any supply or service. The Government will not reimburse any costs incurred in preparation of responses to this notice. This notice does not constitute a solicitation; NRCS is not requesting proposals or quotes at this time.
